title: picardCoefficientTranspose
statement: Fix schemes X, S, W and V [def-pc-scheme], maps f:X to S, k:W to S, r:V to W, an O_X-module L [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Put X_W=X times_S W and X_V=X times_S V using k and r followed by k, and write q_U:X_U to X and p_U:X_U to U for their projections. Set M=q_W tensor-pullback L and N=q_V tensor-pullback L. Form the unique projection lift a:X_V to X_W whose projections are q_V and p_V followed by r. Obtain d:a ordinary-pullback M isomorphic to N by the ordinary-to-tensor left-adjoint comparison followed by the inverse conjugate of pushforward composition [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Form B:Lr^* Rp_W*(M[0]) to Rp_V*(N[0]) by the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by Rp_V* of the single-pullback comparison for a [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] and single(d.hom). Define tau_r:Lp_V* Lr* Rp_W*(M[0]) to N[0] as the transpose of this fixed morphism under the pinned derived adjunction [lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation]. This is an explicit construction, with no test section or source normalization.

def picardCoefficientTranspose {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) :
  ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f (r ≫ k))).obj
      ((derivedPullback r).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L)))) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f (r ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (r ≫ k))).obj L)
